name: hx_constant_effectiveness_discretised
title: Discretised constant-effectiveness heat exchanger with a minimum pinch (sCO2 recuperator)
summary: Counterflow HX split into n_disc equal-enthalpy segments; the duty is limited by a user maximum effectiveness, by an external ideal-outlet maximum heat, by an internal zero-pinch limit and by a minimum segment temperature difference. The Python effectiveness/bisection loops become min-based complementarity conditions. Translation of the LaboThapPy HexCstEffDisc.

verification.reference: Both case studies (RecupHT, GasCooler) of labothappy/component/examples/heat_exchanger/hex_csteff_disc_example.py re-run in a throw-away venv (CoolProp 8.0.0, LaboThapPy commit f03f7f47), plus a tightened brentq zero-pinch reference
verification.notes: Vs the source example: Q_dot +0.11 % (RecupHT, the original's bisection tolerance on Q_dot_max plus the BICUBIC-vs-HEOS backend) and +1.02 % (GasCooler, the original stops at the last 1 % effectiveness step: DT_pinch 11.50 K vs the enforced 10 K); max 1.33 % on h_ex_H (GasCooler) is that Q_dot difference propagated. epsilon exact (0.95), DT_pinch = Pinch_min exactly in the GasCooler case. Vs a tightened exact-root reference: Q_dot +0.012/+0.015 % (property backend only), DT_pinch within 7.6e-5 K. See README Verification.
